title: Anyone can re-mint a token that was burned by the owner
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The minting of tokens is restricted to the beacon contract by enforcing in the `_beforeTokenTransfer` hook that only the beacon can transfer locked tokens. As the default status of a token is locked, non-existing tokens are expected to be locked.  ```solidity     function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal view override {         if (msg.sender != BEACON_CONTRACT_ADDRESS) { @>          if (tokenIsLocked(tokenId)) revert CallerNotBeacon();         } ```  However, it has not been taken into
